description: Coda Local development CLI tool. It comes bundled with the Pack SDK and makes it easy to build and manage Packs from the CLI
name: coda

script: grep -A5 --include=*.ts --exclude-dir=node_modules -r 'addFormula\|addSyncTable\|makeFormula\|makeSyncTable' . | grep -A3 -i formula | grep name: | grep -oE "['\"]\w*['\"]"
